mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 3% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened discount rates affecting future equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 3% and remains >3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero in the tightening regime (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS reverts below 3% within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10,000 jobs in a single month, it indicates strengthening labor market conditions that precede a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate sustained earnings growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the labor strength signal (p > 0.05 in t-test), or PAYEMS growth is not sustained beyond the trigger month.

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in both HOUST (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 2% in the same month suggests weakening demand, which predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates softening economic momentum.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < HOUST previous month - 2% AND RSAFS < RSAFS previous month - 2%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or the demand indicators recover without a sustained rebound in production and sales.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly INDPRO exceeds 115 (index 2017=100) for three consecutive months, it signals robust manufacturing activity that supports a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return via optimism about production capacity and cost competitiveness.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns in the three months following the trigger (p > 0.05), or INDPRO reverts below 115 within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in CPIAUCSL of over 2% in a single month, followed by two consecutive months of stable or rising prices, indicates accelerating inflation and predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as the Fed is likely to raise rates.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL < CPIAUCSL previous month - 2% AND CPIAUCSL next month >= CPIAUCSL previous month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not revert to rising trend within one month.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months, it reflects weakening labor market conditions and is associated with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate lower wage growth and potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05), or UNRATE does not remain below 4% for the full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (industrial production) of at least 3% in a month suggest robust economic momentum, which drives a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates continued growth.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1 previous month * 1.03 AND HOUST > HOUST previous month * 1.03
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05), or the dual momentum signal is not repeated in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 of 5% over three consecutive months indicates weakening overall demand, which predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors reassess valuations in a supply-constrained environment.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the three-month GDPC1 decline, or GDPC1 recovers before the 20-day window closes.
